note: Every figure was checked on the linked page (or the official PDF where the page blocks robots). Rates are annual figures divided by 365 days; they are reported cases, so real numbers are higher. No source measures how many people are newly trafficked per day: trafficking figures are people held at a point in time, or victims detected by authorities.
